summary.text: Phil Ramos, listed by Ballotpedia as Philip Ramos, is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly representing District 6, an office he has held since 2003, and is seeking re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ramos' professional experience includes serving as a detective and police officer for the Suffolk County Police Department, working as an emergency medical technician, and working as a therapy aide for Pilgrim Psychiatric Center.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ramos was assigned to the Aging, Education, Labor, Local Governments and Ways and Means committees.
